metadata.question: Was there more sea ice visible in Hudson Bay (56.271030, -87.160422) on July 29, 2020 than on July 13, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Hudson Bay at coordinates (56.271030, -87.160422) - Dates: July 29, 2020 vs July 13, 2020 - Collection: Sentinel-1 SAR (good for ice detection) or Landsat 8 (optical, but needs cloud masking) - Sentinel-1 is better for ice detection as it penetrates clouds 2. Masking strategy: - For Sentinel-1 SAR: No cloud masking needed, but need to identify ice using VV/VH polarization (ice shows high backscatter) - Alternatively use optical data (Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8) with cloud masking - Ice appears bright in SAR (high backscatter in VV band) - Use a threshold or calculate ice extent as pixels with high backscatter 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If collection is empty: C1 - If valid pixels after processing = 0: C2 - If result is NaN or None: C3 - If ice area on July 29 > July 13: A (more ice) - If ice area on July 29 <= July 13: B (less or equal ice) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define location and dates const location = ee.Geometry.Point([-87.160422, 56.271030]); const date1 = '2020-07-13'; const date2 = '2020-07-29'; // Create buffers around the point (5km radius for local analysis) const geometry = location.buffer(5000); // Acquire Sentinel-1 SAR data (better for ice detection through clouds) const s1_date1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')); const s1_date2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')); const size1 = s1_date1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = s1_date2.size().getInfo(); print("July 13, 2020 S1 images: " + size1); print("July 29, 2020 S1 images: " + size2); // Check if data exists if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { print("Attempting Landsat 8 fallback..."); const ls8_date1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .map(function(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(cloudMask); }); const ls8_date2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .map(function(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(cloudMask); }); const ls_size1 = ls8_date1.size().getInfo(); const ls_size2 = ls8_date2.size().getInfo(); print("Landsat July 13: " + ls_size1); print("Landsat July 29: " + ls_size2); if (ls_size1 === 0 || ls_size2 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } } // Use Sentinel-1 median composite for ice detection (VV band shows ice as bright) let img1, img2; if (size1 > 0 && size2 > 0) { img1 = s1_date1.median(); img2 = s1_date2.median(); // Ice detection: high VV backscatter (dB values > -10) const ice1 = img1.select('VV').gt(-10); const ice2 = img2.select('VV').gt(-10); const iceCount1 = ice1.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9} ).get('VV').getInfo(); const iceCount2 = ice2.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9} ).get('VV').getInfo(); print("Ice pixels July 13: " + iceCount1); print("Ice pixels July 29: " + iceCount2); if (iceCount1 === null || iceCount2 === null || iceCount1 === 0 || iceCount2 === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Compare ice extent if (iceCount2 > iceCount1) { print("More ice on July 29 (" + iceCount2 + " vs " + iceCount1 + ")"); print("A"); } else { print("Less or equal ice on July 29 (" + iceCount2 + " vs " + iceCount1 + ")"); print("B"); } } else { print("C1"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
